release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.38 fixes the remaining Tasks presentation regressions: the Tasks hierarchy now starts collapsed after restart, the module order is Pokémon Center, Walmart, Amazon, Target, Login Cookies, ATC Cookies, recognizable retailer marks are restored reliably on cold start, and Login Cookies / ATC Cookies open as separate module presentations instead of the old combined Target Session Jar selector. No checkout or task execution behavior was changed.
